request: Create a lesson reporting the supported functioning-meter proportion, explaining the observed denominator and designing a specific follow-up before a full-building statement can be made.
objective: Keep a convenience-tested subset distinct from the full installed population and preserve unknown outcomes.

sources.text: Fictional building service report: two hundred ten meters are installed. Only the seventy meters in unlocked utility cupboards were tested; twenty-nine met the stated calibration tolerance.
The remaining one hundred forty meters were behind locked access panels and have no calibration outcomes recorded. Cupboard accessibility determined selection; no random sampling procedure was used.
Each installed meter has a unique ID. A complete report would use the same tolerance and inspection period across all210 meters. No additional tests are supplied.
